title: KymoClass classifies CMT2A mitochondrial motility phenotypes in iPSC motor neurons
summary: KymoClass, an image classifier trained on kymographs of mitochondrial movement, discriminated isogenic MFN2 WT from MFN2 R364W iPSC motor neurons more accurately than speed or stationary-fraction summary statistics and stayed accurate on a held-out biological replicate. Attention scores and vision transformer patch embeddings revealed a previously undescribed stationary-mitochondria subtype, termed jitter, associated with R364W. On three mutations excluded from training (T105A, W740S, R94W), pathogenicity scores were consistent with reported clinical severity. Cell-model preprint.

evidence.tested: Held-out biological replicate and three MFN2 mutations excluded from training.
evidence.unknown: Relevance to patients and to screening use; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts disease phenotype from mitochondrial kymographs and highlights a new motility subtype.
